evaluation_diagnostics.highest_value_structural_change: Make a recurring per-site or per-portfolio service, distributed and clinically governed through a contracted competent water-safety provider, the primary offer, with incident casebooks included and explicit outcome-data rights in the master agreement. This would reduce dependence on sporadic positive cases while aligning authority, distribution, repeat revenue, and data access; it should replace, not merely sit beside, an unproven standalone case fee.
evaluation_diagnostics.main_structural_strength: A narrow, urgent compliance-and-safety trigger is converted into a clearly bounded operator-owned record from accredited result through expert decision, intervention evidence, and accredited retest, and the first pilot avoids costly laboratory integration.
evaluation_diagnostics.primary_score_limiter: There is no demonstrated incremental willingness to pay or viable contribution model, and the sparse event frequency, mandatory expert costs, and incumbent ability to bundle the workflow jointly threaten both economics and scale.

evaluation_diagnostics.highest_value_structural_change: Make a competent water-safety consultancy or an accredited laboratory the contracted channel and commercial customer for a white-label, operator-owned casebook, with an annual portfolio minimum plus usage fees rather than relying mainly on separately sold positive-case activations. A committed partner would align acquisition with the test result, embed qualified governance, and reduce event-frequency and direct-sales fragility while preserving operator consent for any reusable data.
evaluation_diagnostics.main_structural_strength: The opportunity is anchored to a narrow, high-stakes operational trigger and deliberately separates workflow software from accredited testing and competent expert decisions, enabling a low-integration pilot that fits the founder's technical strengths and limited initial capital.
evaluation_diagnostics.primary_score_limiter: The model has no demonstrated source of attractive recurring economics: qualifying events may be sparse, operators may not pay separately, expert and support costs may absorb the case fee, and incumbent labs or platforms can bundle the same workflow through stronger channels.
evaluation_diagnostics.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Existing laboratory portals and Legionella platforms already offer trend analytics, dashboards, and non-compliance management, while qualified consultants and laboratories sit closest to both the triggering result and remediation process; this directly weakens claimed differentiation, referral leverage, and separate willingness to pay.

evaluation_diagnostics.highest_value_structural_change: Convert the broad resolution desk into a pre-contracted exchange program for one demonstrably failure-prone legacy inverter or optimizer family: aggregate committed case flow from a small installer cohort, secure a qualified tester-refurbisher and pooled lawful inventory, and offer a pre-priced compatibility and service-level promise. Expand only after that single-cell program proves repeat volume and positive all-in contribution.
evaluation_diagnostics.main_structural_strength: The candidate is disciplined about serving only high-avoidance unresolved failures, starts with genuine case access through the family installer, and avoids inventory and regulated physical operations until evidence supports them.
evaluation_diagnostics.primary_score_limiter: There is no evidence that enough paid cases remain after OEM and SecondSol resolution to support attractive contribution, repeat account economics, or a plausible path to the founder's wealth objective.

evaluation_diagnostics.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A prospective cohort of Polish installers should provide case logs showing the annual failure count, the share still unresolved after OEM and SecondSol searches, documented avoided-repowering cost, quoted customer fees, paid conversion, resolution rate, full contribution after testing/returns/warranty/insurance/support, repeat frequency, and retention; this should be paired with signed qualified-partner terms covering supply, testing, service levels, non-waste documentation, fitment responsibility, and liability.
evaluation_diagnostics.highest_value_structural_change: Replace the pure residual-case success-fee model with a contracted installer portfolio service: charge a modest recurring fee for triage, OEM and marketplace routing, and documentation across all submitted cases, plus a success fee for difficult resolutions, with annual case minimums and tightly bounded guarantees. This would reduce adverse selection, monetize the broader workflow, improve revenue predictability, and accelerate the case graph, but should be adopted only if pilots demonstrate willingness to pay.
evaluation_diagnostics.main_structural_strength: A capital-light, installer-facing resolution workflow can start with real family-installer cases, use existing OEM and marketplace supply rather than fund inventory, and potentially compound verified fitment outcomes into a useful local data asset.
evaluation_diagnostics.primary_score_limiter: The packet does not quantify how many economically valuable cases remain after OEM and SecondSol channels, nor whether those unusually difficult cases can be resolved repeatedly at positive contribution and sufficient account-level frequency to create scalable owner earnings.
evaluation_diagnostics.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: SecondSol already offers the near-exact marketplace, testing, repair, logistics, and spare-parts stack to more than 60000 users, while OEM replacement can resolve technically substitutable failures quickly; this directly compresses the candidate into a small, fragmented, and potentially adverse-selected remainder.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Repeated paid disposal batches from multiple fleet or dealer accounts with lawful outcome retention, measured improvement in reserve accuracy, conversion or time-to-sale versus the existing process, positive contribution after tests and integration, and customer renewal across successive batches.
records.primary_score_limiter: The business does not control fleet transaction flow or closed-sale outcomes, yet those permissions are simultaneously required for distribution, demonstrated customer value, and the proposed data moat.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: BCA already embeds AVILOO battery grading inside a large European BEV auction for EUR 40 per vehicle, giving an incumbent both low-cost diagnostics and direct access to bids and completed-sale outcomes.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A paid anchor agreement granting narrowly scoped feed, processing, and derived-data rights, followed by a representative pilot that measures change volume, extraction and exception accuracy, qualified-review minutes, integration and support effort, fully loaded contribution margin, manufacturer adoption, renewal intent, and the distributor's quantified avoided cost or service benefit.
records.primary_score_limiter: The entire model depends on an unvalidated distributor anchor that must simultaneously pay, grant timely processing rights, drive account adoption, and support sufficient volume and contract value to cover review, integration, security, support, and insurance costs.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Four established vendors already market supplier collaboration, specification change control, allergen propagation, BOM linkage, and recipe-to-label impact analysis, directly weakening the claim that the proposed functional layer is scarce or difficult for incumbents to bundle.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Run paid pilots across at least two independent multi-site hotel portfolios and document accepted case and annual prices, eligible-case incidence, sales cycle and acquisition effort, expert minutes, support and insurance cost, contribution and payback, renewal or expansion behavior, referral conversion, explicit reusable-data rights, and a measured reduction in response time, labor, documentation defects, or failed retests versus the incumbent process.
records.primary_score_limiter: The concept has not shown that hotel operators will buy this coordination separately from laboratories, consultants, or facility systems at a price and frequency that covers acquisition, expert review, support, insurance, and secure operations; without that, neither recurring economics nor the data advantage works.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Laboratory portals and specialist Legionella platforms already advertise trend analysis, dashboards, and non-compliance management, while official guidance requires system-specific competent interpretation. Together, this indicates that the software layer is bundleable and substitutable and cannot itself deliver the decisive control outcome.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A prospective cohort of real off-warranty failures showing the OEM-and-SecondSol-unresolved rate, at least several paid successful resolutions, all-in contribution after partner and risk costs, repeat submissions from the same installer accounts, and documented avoided repowering cost.
records.primary_score_limiter: There is no evidence that enough valuable cases remain unresolved after OEM and SecondSol searches to support recurring installer revenue and positive contribution after testing, warranty, returns, support, and liability costs.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: SecondSol already serves more than 60000 users with over 250000 spare parts plus testing, repair, logistics, auctions, and recycling, while OEM replacement programs can resolve technically substitutable legacy failures quickly.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A paid Polish dealer or fleet pilot showing incremental conversion or sale-price lift, repeat orders, all-in contribution after license and technician costs, supported-model and inconclusive-test rates, and buyer or lender acceptance relative to incumbent certificates.
records.primary_score_limiter: The entrant has no demonstrated advantage or exclusive channel against diagnostic and auction incumbents that already combine credible testing, model databases, and low-priced transaction-integrated reports.

records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Existing laboratory and specialist vendors already provide trend analytics and compliance dashboards, while official guidance states that samples alone can miss system risk and require competent contextual interpretation, undermining a generic analytics add-on.
